title: Open search tooling for paired-cube complex words (no κ claim)
body:
Tooling only. **No new κ is claimed**, and no certificate or verification group changes.

Stacked on #161 at `d14e29157bc905be1ced0776dd893d0714013f3a`. Its word, modules, gauges and physical checker are prerequisites, not contributions of this PR.

## What this adds

The physical frame descents and compensated reuse pairs of the paired-cube complex words are shipped as frozen inputs (`references/paired-cube/physical/{frames,pairs}.json`); no producer is included in the repository. New modules also need frozen carrier arcs. `research/paired-cube-open-search/` supplies open producers for both:

- **`generator.py`**: physical frame descent (alternating passes; each operation moves to the lower or upper nested bound when cheaper) and maximum-weight donor→recipient reuse pairs. It runs PR161's unchanged `scripts/paired_cube_physical.py` on its own output.
- **`frames_open.py`**: PR161's compiler plus open maximum carrier matching (Hopcroft–Karp) when no frozen arcs are given.
- **`modules_open.py`**: all-but-one variants (cyclic intervals, prefix/suffix, tree split).
- **`search.py`**: a parallel genetic search over triple coordinates and all-but-one module.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/paired-cube-open-search/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/paired-cube-open-search/reproduce.py     # about 40 s
```

Every line passes PR161's checker, including its exact aliased dirty-scratch replay:

| Word | Pairs | W | Complex saving (float) | vs PR161 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| PR161 frozen plan (asserted equal to its certificate) | 2,970 | 15,681 | 5.8856699e-4 | — |
| PR161 word, open generator | 2,970 | 15,681 | 5.8905532e-4 | +0.083% |
| Cyclic all-but-one, open matching + generator | 2,970 | 14,361 | 5.9306799e-4 | +0.765% |

A two-generation search smoke run reached 5.9334228e-4 in 65 s on 6 workers.

These are complex-supplier discovery scores. Since #163/#164/#165 the bit supplier binds, so they do not raise κ alone. They are offered for the next stacked word. Any κ still needs the usual exact supplier, bit and assembly certificates.

## Speed

One configuration takes about 7 s with warm caches, against about 74 s for the straightforward loop:

- `basis()` returns the unique reduced echelon form, so it is memoized exactly and shared with the selector and checker.
- Donor-in-gauge containment is computed for all distinct frame pairs as one F2 parity matrix in numpy.

Each worker uses about 2.6 GB.

CI: `.github/workflows/paired-cube-open-search.yml` runs `reproduce.py` and a one-configuration search on Python 3.13, with pinned numpy and scipy.

Credits: icekylinx (#144 paired cubes; `frames_open.py` is a modified copy of the Apache-2.0 compiler, with notice retained), eumemic (#157/#161 word and physical checker; #131/#143), jamesyc (#124), and the #130 frame lemma. Prepared by Joel Pulikkan with Anthropic Claude assistance; Apache-2.0.
